Why UK Clubs Order Kit Direct

Grassroots and semi-pro clubs in the UK are usually buying teamwear through a local supplier who orders it from a factory abroad anyway. The club pays the markup, waits on someone else's production queue, and gets whatever base garment the supplier stocks.

Buying direct from the factory removes the middle step. Fifteen kits per design covers a single side with spares, sponsor artwork is included rather than charged as an extra, and DDP delivery means no customs surprise when the boxes arrive. If you need American football uniforms rather than football kit, see our American football programme instead.

Questions

What is the minimum order for custom football kits?

15 kits per design - one squad with spares - with junior and adult sizes mixed freely in the same order. Training wear starts at 20 pieces.

How much does a custom football kit cost?

Quoted per design within 24 hours. Our published pricing page lists full sublimated kits - shirt, shorts and socks - from $20.00 per set at 15 sets, falling 10-40% at higher volumes.

Can you print sponsor logos on our shirts?

Yes, and at no extra charge. Sponsor panels are sublimated into the fabric along with the rest of the design, so they will not crack or peel, and a sponsor change simply means new artwork on the next run.

Do you supply goalkeeper kits with the team order?

Yes - contrasting keeper shirts, with a padded elbow option, are produced alongside the outfield order in whatever quantity your squad needs.

How long does a football kit order take?

Free mockup in 24-48 hours, sample in 5-7 business days, production 2-3 weeks and express DDP delivery in 3-7 days - order before pre-season, not during it.
